detail.longDescription: Rackspace Spot, offered by San Antonio-based Rackspace Technology, announced service restoration after a breach disrupted cloud administration, but its status notice kept new organization sign-ups paused until noon Eastern on Nov. 25. The notice says existing customers can keep bidding and running workloads as usual. The console outage blocked cluster management and credential rotation. Rackspace revoked sessions and tokens, removed unauthorized containers and rotated keys; a customer later reported narrower management failures, with no subsequent update establishing whether those persisted. Public evidence does not establish which secrets were copied or whether credentials were misused. # RackspaceSpot # Kubernetes # Cyberattack # CloudComputing # IncidentResponse # CredentialSecurity https:// dysruptionhub.com/rackspace-sp ot-breach-cloud-management/
